description: This file defines the Zend_Loader class, which provides static methods for loading PHP classes and files within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for class autoloading, file inclusion, security checks, and managing the autoload registration.

classes.name: Zend_Loader
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for class and file loading, autoload registration, and security checks within the Zend Framework.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Loads a class from a PHP file based on class name and optional directories, with fallback to include_path.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Includes a PHP file, searching in specified directories and the include_path, with optional include_once behavior.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if a file is readable, considering include_path.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Autoloads a class using loadClass, suitable for spl_autoload_register.

methods.name: registerAutoload
methods.description: Registers or unregisters the autoload method with spl_autoload, with checks for method existence.
